1.consolidated_definition: . Vedar, poner el veto a una ley. Ac. “Se nos informa que el Alcalde vetó la ordenanza.” El Yunque, Yauco, 10 de marzo de 1934.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To veto a law; to place a veto on an ordinance. 

Example: "We are informed that the Mayor vetoed the ordinance."
